propositions: The code-review extension seam does not dynamically fan in project-owned LLM-backed criteria during Pass 1 discovery despite routing infrastructure existing
The eval surface and CLI resolution are plan-review-biased and do not adequately support code-review solver arms for new project criteria
Pass 3 does not consistently consume repository-effective threshold, posture, and nit-suppression values from routing configuration for project criteria
Logical project criterion ids must be transparently mapped to validator-safe physical ids during prompt and eval dispatch without introducing special cases

The project.review-phase-boundaries criterion must enforce strict boundaries preventing Pass 1 from assessing severity or prescribing remediation, Pass 2 from discovering or deciding, Pass 3 from invoking LLM logic, and Pass 4 from re-adjudicating disposition
